incident_text: Heavy smoke is rising behind a farm and a house stands close to the smoke. We think a wildfire is coming toward the house.

result.scene_summary: A large, dark, and turbulent cloud formation dominates the sky above a rural landscape, with a house and trees visible in the foreground.

observations.description: Large, dark, swirling cloud mass, possibly smoke or storm cloud, filling the sky.
A single house with a pitched roof and porch is visible on the right side of the image.
Dark trees form a line across the horizon, with some scattered trees and bushes near the house.
A field of dry grass or crops in the foreground.
